extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and stores.

extDescription.message: Hide YouTube videos spoken in languages you choose, in search and recommendations. Free, private, no data collected.

filteringOn.description: Screen reader label of the on/off switch.

lede.message: Hide YouTube videos spoken in the languages you pick. Everything runs on your device.
lede.description: Intro line on the settings page.

noLanguages.message: No languages blocked yet. Pick one below to start.

blockAllExcept.description: Button. LANG is the browser's language, e.g. English.

undo.description: Link after Block all / Unblock all.

blockingSummary.description: Shown instead of the list of chips when many languages are blocked.

blockingSummaryExcept.description: Same, when only a few languages are left. LIST is a comma-separated list of language names.

stopBlocking.description: Tooltip of the × on a language chip.

addLanguagePlaceholder.description: Search box placeholder in the toolbar popup.

surfaceHome.message: Home page, subscriptions and other feeds

surfaceWatch.message: "Up next" suggestions next to a video

deepCheckHelp.message: Reads the spoken language that YouTube itself has recorded for each video (its auto-caption language and original audio track). This catches videos with translated or English titles. It loads each new video's page from YouTube once, and the result is remembered on this device. Turn this off to judge by titles only.

blockDubbedTitle.message: Also hide videos with a dubbed track in a blocked language

blockDubbedHelp.message: For example, an English video that also offers Hindi dubbed audio.

hideUntilCheckedTitle.message: Hide videos until they are checked

hideUntilCheckedHelp.message: Avoids briefly seeing a video before it is hidden. Videos may take a moment to appear.

actionDim.message: Fade them out with a label saying why

debugTitle.message: Show LangBlock's reasoning on every video

debugHelp.message: Adds a small label to each video saying what LangBlock found, and fades hidden videos instead of removing them. A video with no label wasn't recognised by LangBlock. Turn this off when you're done.
debugHelp.description: Translations add: the labels are in English.

cacheCountLabel.message: Videos remembered so they aren't checked again:

footerFree.message: LangBlock is free. It collects no data and sends nothing anywhere except normal requests to YouTube.

donateShort.description: Donation link in the small popup.

allSettings.description: Link from the popup to the settings page.

statusPick.message: Pick a language below to start.

statusInactive.message: Not filtering on this page (see All settings).

statusOpenYoutube.message: Open YouTube and LangBlock filters it automatically.

hiddenBy.description: Label on a faded video. WHY is e.g. 'Hindi (spoken)'.

whySpoken.description: Reason: the language spoken in the video.

whyTags.description: Reason: the tags or hashtags the uploader gave the video.
